papers.title_en: Bochner-Yano Type Theorems for Conformal Killing Vector Fields under Curvature Pinching Conditions
papers.authors: Teng Huang, Qiang Tan, Weiwei Wang
papers.evidence: 共形Killing矢量场的Bochner-Yano型定理，涉及梯度估计与Moser迭代
papers.tldr: 针对闭黎曼流形上共形Killing向量场在曲率挤压条件下的性质，本文建立了新的Bochner型恒等式，并借助Moser迭代获得锐利梯度估计。该估计表明，当Ricci曲率满足适当上界时，非平凡共形Killing向量场必无处为零；在偶数维且欧拉示性数非零的流形上，共形Killing向量场恒为零，从而共形变换群有限。这一结果将Yano与Bochner的经典刚性定理从非正Ricci曲率推广到小正Ricci曲率，并推广了Chen与Han关于Killing向量场的近期结论。
papers.abstract_en: In this article, we investigate conformal Killing vector fields on closed Riemannian manifolds under a curvature pinching condition. By establishing a new Bochner-type identity for the $1$-form dual to a conformal Killing vector field, we derive a sharp gradient estimate via a Moser iteration procedure. Based on this estimate, we prove that, under a suitable upper bound on the Ricci curvature, every nontrivial conformal Killing vector field must be nowhere vanishing. Consequently, on even-dimensional manifolds with non-zero Euler characteristic, every conformal Killing vector field vanishes identically, which in turn implies that the conformal transformation group of such a manifold is finite. Our results extend the classical rigidity theorems of Yano and Bochner from the setting of non-positive Ricci curvature to that of small positive Ricci curvature, and generalize the recent results of Chen and Han from Killing vector fields to conformal Killing vector fields.

papers.evidence: 共形不变的尖旋度-Sobolev不等式及其极值分类是几何分析偏微分方程的重要成果
papers.tldr: 针对Rivière以来长期未解的curl-Sobolev不等式尖锐性问题，在n≡3 mod 4的球面上证明了共形不变的sharp不等式，常数达到(n+1)/2 ω_n^{1/n}，并利用Killing形式完全分类极值。该结果通过共形不变性与变分方法，解决了几何和物理中多个公开猜想：圆度量是唯一优化者，Hopf映射在3-能量与Faddeev-Skyrme能量中的全局最小性，以及Dirac零模的sharp下界与存在性判据，对n=3情形给出了完整回答。
papers.abstract_en: We solve a longstanding problem, going back at least to Rivière 1998 and open even in the physically most relevant case $n=3$, by proving a sharp curl-Sobolev inequality on $\mathbb{S}^n$ when $n\equiv 3\pmod 4$: for every $\frac{n-1}{2}$-form $α$, the conformally invariant quotient satisfies (with positive denominator) \[ \frac{\Big(\int_{\mathbb{S}^n}|{\rm curl}α|^{\frac{2n}{n+1}}\,{\rm dV}\Big)^{\frac{n+1}{n}}}{\int_{\mathbb{S}^n}\langle{\rm curl}α,α\rangle\,{\rm dV}}   \ge \frac{n+1}{2}\,ω_n^{\frac1n}. \] We also classify all extremals in terms of Killing forms. By conformal invariance, the same result holds on $\mathbb{R}^n$.   We then give geometric and variational applications that settle several open conjectures in geometry and mathematical physics. First, we show that on $\mathbb{S}^n$ the round metric is the unique optimizer for the conformal invariant $μ([g_{\rm st}])$. Second, we prove that the unique minimizers of the $3$-energy $\int_{\mathbb{S}^3}|{\rm d} u|^3$ in the homotopy class of the Hopf map $π:\mathbb{S}^3\to\mathbb{S}^2$ are exactly $π\circΦ$ with $Φ\in{\rm Conf}^+(\mathbb{S}^3)$, confirming a conjecture of Rivière. Third, for the Faddeev-Skyrme energy $\mathcal{FS}_ρ$ on $\mathbb{S}^3$, we establish global minimality of the Hopf map in the full predicted range: for every coupling constant $ρ\le \sqrt{2}$, the unique global minimizers in its homotopy class are precisely $π\circ R$ with $R\in\mathrm{SO}(4)$, as expected since Ward 1999. Fourth, in the presence of Dirac zero modes on $\mathbb{S}^3$, we prove the sharp lower bound $\|{\rm curl} A\|_{3/2} \ge 3ω_3^{\frac 2 3}$ for the magnetic field and characterize equality in terms of Killing spinors; in particular, this yields a sharp criterion for the existence of zero modes and answers a question of Frank-Loss for $n=3$.

papers.title_en: Volume Stability for Hyperbolic Manifolds and Applications to General Relativity
papers.evidence: 双曲流形的几何分析，曲率与体积收敛
papers.tldr: 针对闭双曲三维流形，本文证明尖锐的体积稳定性：若度量的标量曲率不低于负六且体积趋于双曲体积，则取子列后，在去掉体积趋于零的区域上，度量在零阶连续意义下收敛到双曲度量。这一结果将体积刚性推广为定量形式。作为应用，它确立了广义相对论中费希尔-蒙克里夫约化哈密顿量在洛伦兹锥基态的稳定性，给出了常平均曲率归一化下真空数据收敛的严格表述。
papers.abstract_en: We prove a sharp volume-stability theorem for closed hyperbolic three-manifolds. Let \((M,h)\) be closed hyperbolic with \(\operatorname{Ric}_h=-2h\), and let \(g_i\) be smooth metrics on \(M\) satisfying $R(g_i)\geq -6, \operatorname{Vol}_{g_i}(M)\longrightarrow \operatorname{Vol}_h(M)$. After passing to a subsequence, there exist \(Z_i\subset M\), smooth domains \(K_i\subset M\), and diffeomorphisms $ψ_i:K_i\longrightarrow M\setminus Z_i $ such that $\operatorname{Vol}_{g_i}(Z_i)\longrightarrow0, \operatorname{Vol}_h(M\setminus K_i)\longrightarrow0, $ and $ \|ψ_i^*g_i-h\|_{C^0(K_i,h)}\longrightarrow0. $ Thus near-equality in the sharp hyperbolic volume bound forces tensorial \(C^0\)-convergence to the hyperbolic metric outside regions of vanishing volume. As an application, we establish stability of the Fischer--Moncrief reduced Hamiltonian at the Lorentz-cone ground state: after CMC normalization, near-minimizing compact vacuum data in the hyperbolic topological class converge, modulo sets of vanishing volume, to the hyperbolic Lorentz-cone geometry in tensorial \(C^0\). This provides a rigorous volume-dominance formulation of the Fischer--Moncrief asymptotic picture.

papers.title_en: Sharp gradient estimates for a class of singular/degenerate fully nonlinear elliptic equations with oblique boundary conditions and Hamiltonian terms
papers.evidence: 奇异退化完全非线性椭圆方程的尖边界正则性为几何偏微分方程提供可迁移的分析工具
papers.tldr: 针对一类含Hamiltonian项的奇异/退化完全非线性椭圆方程，研究其在C^1域上斜边界条件下的边界正则性。在较一般的奇异/退化假设下，引入统一框架处理边界耦合与退化效应。通过构造罚函数和整体估计，建立了到边界的sharp C^{1,α}正则性。结果统一并推广了已有边界正则性结论，适用于多种奇异/退化模型。
papers.abstract_en: This paper focus on a class of singular or degenerate fully nonlinear elliptic equations with Hamiltonian terms under oblique boundary conditions on $C^{1}$ domains. Under quite general conditions on the singularity/degeneracy of the model, we establish the sharp $C^{1,α}$ regularity up to the boundary within a unified framework.

papers.title_en: Inviscid Incompressible Limit for Degenerate Compressible Navier-Stokes Equations on Expanding Domains
papers.authors: Tong Tang, Emil Wiedemann, Lu Zhu
papers.tldr: 针对三维可压Navier-Stokes方程，其黏性依赖于密度，在扩张区域上同时研究无黏极限与低马赫数极限。从非准备初值出发，证明极限系统为不可压Euler方程。该结果将Feireisl等人关于常黏性方程的工作推广到密度依赖黏性情形，首次在同一框架下建立无黏与不可压极限。
papers.abstract_en: We simultaneously investigate the inviscid and Low Mach number limits on expanding domains for the $3D$ degenerate compressible Navier-Stokes equations, whose viscosity depends on density. Starting from ill-prepared data, we show the limit system is the incompressible Euler system.   Our result extends a previous result of Feireisl et al. concerning the constant viscosity Navier-Stokes equations, and is the first to establish the inviscid and incompressible limits at the same time for density-dependent viscosity.

papers.title_en: Fractal Remez inequality on the sphere and observability of the heat equation
papers.evidence: 球面分形Remez不等式与热方程尖锐可观测性，属几何PDE结果
papers.tldr: 本文研究球面热方程的可观测性，关键在于发展分形Remez不等式。借助具有正(n-2+δ)-Hausdorff容量的分形集上的精细测度估计，证明球面多项式在该子集上的上确界可控制其全局范数，且常数仅依赖于维数与次数。基于此，对任意δ∈(0,1)建立了热方程的尖锐可观测性不等式，显著改进了Burq与Moyano在球形设置下的结果。此外，该框架还进一步导出带超二次势|z|^{2m}的全空间热方程低维可观测性，扩展了应用范围。
papers.abstract_en: This paper is concerned with Remez-type inequalities and their applications in observability inequality. Our aim is twofold. First, we establish the following fractal Remez's inequality on the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^{n-1}$ \begin{align*} \sup_{\mathbb{S}^{n-1}} |p|\le C(M,N,n,δ)\sup_{M} |p|, \end{align*} where $M \subset \mathbb{S}^{n-1}$ ($n \ge 2$) is a fractal set of positive $(n-2+δ)$-Hausdorff content for arbitrary $δ\in (0,1)$, and $p$ is a spherical polynomial of degree at most $N\in \mathbb{Z}^+$. Second, building upon this fractal framework, we establish sharp observability inequalities for the heat equation on the sphere, again valid for all $δ\in (0, 1)$, which improve the result of Burq and Moyano [J. Eur. Math. Soc. (JEMS), 25 (4) (2023)] in the spherical setting. Furthermore, as an additional application, we prove a lower-dimensional observability inequality for the heat equation with super-quadratic potentials $V(x) = |x|^{2m}$ ($m \in \mathbb{Z}^+, m\ge 2$) on the whole space $\mathbb{R}^n$.
